citations.claim: at first violating step 1 controller_force 250.3378616738172 exceeds fmax 194.57639905651862; body speed 3.356 here reflects force applied

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 26.406868818238337 to 15.0 (single field change) to lower kp*velocity-error below fmax; predicted force would be ~142N <194.58 and violation disappears

explanation: Controller computes force as kp * velocity-error (+ noise) but fails to clamp to fmax. At step 0 velocity is (0, -5.84); desired velocity toward waypoint (12.1,8.8) is ~ (4.9,2.2) giving error magnitude ~9.4. kp=26.41 gives ~248 N before noise, 250.34 N after noise, exceeding fmax=194.58 at step 1. Inspect shows controller_force 250.34 at step 1. Lowering kp to 15 reduces commanded force below limit and violation disappears, confirming cause is missing fmax clamp.
vision_note: Tiles 0 and 1 show the red controlled body on the left remaining almost stationary far from the green waypoint near the top-center. No visible wall penetration, tunneling, or exiting the arena occurs between the two steps; the force-limit exceedance has no obvious geometric signature in the frames.
